dedupe_keys.name: oecd municipal waste generation and treatment df munw by country since 1975

description: This OECD dataset is the main international time series of how much municipal waste countries generate and how they treat it. Published by the OECD Environment Directorate in its Data Explorer, it reports municipal waste generated, including household waste, and the amounts sent to recycling, composting, incineration with and without energy recovery, landfill and other recovery or disposal, in tonnes and per person. When read through the SDMX API, total generation covered 66 reporting areas, OECD members, several large partner economies and OECD and EU aggregates, for years from 1975 to 2024, with gaps by country. The data are free to view in the Data Explorer and available to download as CSV or Excel or through the API. Caveats: definitions of municipal waste differ between countries, early years are sparse, and treatment categories may not sum to generation. Coverage is mainly OECD and partner countries. Simulation uses: national waste generation and treatment baselines for landfill, incineration and recycling capacity planning and waste-sector emission scenarios. Related records: Eurostat's municipal waste statistics (data-eurostat-env-wasmun) give a comparable series for European countries.
